critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1516 lines – well past the 700-line split threshold. Split into routers/ (auth, content, exam, orders, admin, settings, import, leaderboard, seed) before next iteration.

_sync_sections: when a section 'expires in the past but we haven't visited for a while', the while-loop only advances while now > end. If the user is idle across multiple sections, each hop adds that section's full duration without saving/zeroing time — fine per spec (section_ends_at anchored to original start), but worth confirming intent. Current behaviour: unanswered intermediate sections are effectively skipped with 0 answers, matching SBI PO style.
DialogContent in ImportDialog (and likely other dialogs) emits React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Add DialogDescription for a11y.
_board sort key uses 10**9 as sentinel for None time_taken_sec; prefer math.inf for clarity.
import endpoint accepts up to 5MB AND up to 2000 rows but reads the full file into memory before counting – a 5MB CSV with pathological content could still DOS. Acceptable at current scale.
ImportDialog sends category_id/positive_marks/negative_marks via FormData even when blank; backend tolerates it. OK.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Imported questions were undone. TEST_* users/questions/tests cleaned up by teardown_module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run iteration-3 backend tests: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py -v -o addopts=''`. Pytest.ini has xdist args that must be overridden. The timed sectional test (TestTimedSectional) registers a TEST_sec_* user when student@lms.com has already submitted the SBI mock; it cleans up itself. Expiry simulation is done by setting section_ends_at='2020-01-01' in Mongo and calling GET /api/attempts/{id}. Student has an in-progress SSC Sectional Mock 1 attempt and a submitted SBI Sectional Mock 1 result from prior runs — tests handle both states.
